result.rationale: The diff shows the server coercing blank category_id to uncategorized (`host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?` in embeddable_hosts_controller.rb) while the component on save success does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` with the unchanged, possibly-null categoryId. So a save with an empty category leaves the client record's category undefined while the server persisted the uncategorized category — a real client/server divergence introduced by this diff, though minor in impact.

judged_text: On save success the component sets host.category to Discourse.Category.findById(categoryId), but when the user leaves the category chooser empty the server coerces category_id to the uncategorized category while findById(null) yields undefined, so the client-side record diverges from the persisted row. The admin saves a host with no category chosen; the server stores the uncategorized category, but the row renders no category badge and the next edit() reads host.category.id as undefined, sending a blank category_id again — the displayed state never reflects what was actually saved, misdirecting any admin trying to verify the configuration.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6#save`, the client sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and on success forces `host.category` to `Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))`. On the server, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` coerces blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. If the chooser is left empty, `categoryId` is null/blank, so `findById(null)` yields `undefined` and the component sets `host.category` to `undefined`, while the persisted row has a real category_id. The template renders `{{category-badge host.category}}`, so it will show no category even though one was saved, and `edit()` reads `this.get('host.category.id')` which will be undefined and continue re-sending blank `category_id`.
